subject.title: Control UI: retire the Overview page; move connection to Settings, attention to sidebar chips, unify /new with the start screen

question: Should the Control UI remove the live Overview route and adopt the proposed chat-first redistribution of its remaining responsibilities?
rationale: The direction is vision-aligned and sponsored, but it deliberately changes first-party information architecture and route compatibility, which automation cannot approve safely.

options.title: Adopt coordinated redesign
options.body: Review and land the linked PR once responsibility transfer, route policy, and browser proof are satisfactory.

options.title: Retain or split Overview
options.body: Keep the route and approve narrower navigation or start-screen changes if any Overview responsibility lacks a safe new home.

recommendation.title: Adopt coordinated redesign
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR once responsibility transfer, route policy, and browser proof are satisfactory.

likelyOwner.reason: He explicitly sponsors the direction and has recent history in the adjacent UI and session surfaces.
